words.def: to move up towards the top of something
to jump into water or through the air with your head first
to fall, or to let something fall
to move down quickly, without any control
to push yourself off the ground into the air
to come down onto the ground after being in the air
to raise something to a higher position
to leave the ground and start to fly
to remove something by pulling it — here, to open a parachute
equipment that opens like a large umbrella and slows your fall
a very large bag filled with gas, which can carry people into the sky
the small closed part of a spacecraft in which a person travels
a group of people whose job is to save someone who is in danger
something difficult that you succeed in doing
